tests.description: Reference: the pcond block of mp_wsm6_run (phys/physics_mmm/mp_wsm6.F90, ctessum-claude/MMM-physics fork 52cfbd7, instrumented) dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/WRF fork and replayed through the real64 (kind_phys = real64) kernels/wsm6_driver at the WRF step. Inputs are the dumped state entering the block (t_upd, q_upd, qc_upd after the process-rate update and sedimentation; p; the start-of-call xl and cpm), real32 values widened to real64 as the driver read them; the expected pcond, T*, qv* and qc* are the replay's pcond, t_out, q_out and qc_out (the kernel's outputs of this sub-step, which follow the adjustment directly apart from the qc <= qmin padding). POINTWISE and STEP-FREE: the adjustment is applied once per sub-step, so pcond = dq_applied/dtcld is the increment divided by the dumped dtcld and no small-dt replay is involved (a small-dt replay of the kernel would only rescale pcond by 1/dt, FORTRAN_BUGS.md note N3). Real64 replay vs real32 dump: pcond 1.6e-5 (9983) to 8.4e-5 (7980) relative, qc_out 3e-6 to 8e-6, t_out and q_out <= 6e-7 -- the real32 kernel loses digits in the difference qv - qsat. Residual between this component and the real64 kernel (measured with zero tolerances over all four regimes): pcond <= 1.7e-10 kg/kg/s absolute (4.4e-6 of the column maximum in the condensing column, 1.3e-5 in the weaker evaporating one), T* <= 4.9e-6 K, qv* and qc* <= 2.0e-9 kg/kg; it comes from the real32 WRF constants inside the kernel (t0c = 273.1499939, psat = 610.78003, cpv = 1846.4000244, rv = 461.6000061, ep2 = 0.62175041, through qsat at 4.4e-7 of its value, as in saturation.esm) which this component takes at their nominal values from lib/wrf_constants.esm; near the saturation point the relative error of the small difference qv - qsat is correspondingly larger, so spot checks are placed on the strongly active layers and use rel 1e-4. Tolerances are 5-10x above the measured residual: Linf_error bounds pcond abs 1e-9 kg/kg/s, T* abs 2.5e-5 K, qv* and qc* abs 1e-8 kg/kg; spot checks on the four most active layers pcond rel 1e-4 (measured <= 3e-5), T* rel 1e-7 (<= 1.6e-8), qc* rel 5e-5 (<= 6e-6). The zero-condensate SCM regime is asserted exactly (abs 0): the limiter returns 0 and the adjusted state equals the input state bit-for-bit.. Regime: em_quarter_ss supercell step 250, tile row j = 23, column i = 24 (the warm_rain.esm reference column), dtcld = 12 s: a saturated updraft (rh up to 1.55 before the adjustment) in which 19 of the 21 cloudy layers are supersaturated after the process rates and condense up to 3.75e-5 kg/kg/s (4.5e-4 kg/kg per sub-step), while 2 layers (the cloud base and top) evaporate and both lose ALL their cloud water (the -qc bound is active there); the vapor cap is never active.
